footer.tagline: Small-batch cookies made with love in Jasin, Melaka.
footer.copyright: Lyn's Little Kitchen. Baked with care.

home.heroIntro: Small-batch cookies with crisp edges, generous centres and the kind of comfort worth sharing.
home.kitchenText: Lyn's Little Kitchen is a home-based bakery in Jasin. Every order is mixed, shaped and baked in small batches.

about.heroTitle: The good things take a little longer.
about.heroIntro: Small batches, baked close to delivery and packed for the people you're thinking of.
about.originPara1: Lyn's Little Kitchen began with a simple love for a warm cookie and the people waiting to share it. What started at home is still made that way: in small batches, with familiar ingredients and time for the details.
about.originPara2: We bake close to delivery because the best part is never just the cookie. It's opening the box, catching that first buttery scent, and passing one along.
about.promisesTitle: A few things we never rush.

promises.title: Generous flavours
promises.text: Cookies made for the kind of sharing that calls for one more piece.

promises.title: Baked close to delivery
promises.text: Each order is prepared with care so it arrives fragrant, comforting, and ready to enjoy.

promises.title: Packed for sharing
promises.text: Every box is packed neatly for a treat at home, a small gift, or the table.

about.closingTitle: There's always room for one more.
about.closingText: Whether you are ordering for a quiet afternoon, a thoughtful gift, or a table full of people, we'll make your box with care from the first tray to the last fold.
about.noteTitle: Made slowly. Meant to be shared.
about.noteText: Our next bake is always worth looking forward to. Follow along, or drop us a message when you have a box in mind.

howToOrder.heroIntro: Five simple steps, baked with care in our little Jasin kitchen.

steps.title: Choose your cookies

steps.title: We bake
